basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Dragon Quest enthusiast based in Seattle, WA. I spend my days working as a software engineer, and my nights exploring virtual worlds. I've been a fan of RPGs since childhood, and Dragon Quest has always been my favorite series. I love discussing game mechanics and strategies, and I'm particularly fascinated by game design and storytelling. Outside of gaming, I enjoy hiking and exploring the Pacific Northwest. Currently single, and I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in computer science and have been self-teaching game design principles through online courses and extensive gameplay. My interest in Dragon Quest started with DQ VIII on the PS2, and I have since played every installment in the series, including remakes. My professional background in software development has given me insights into game mechanics and coding, which I often share in discussions.
